let currentCategory = "all";
let allClasses = [];
// 扁平化所有类
function flattenClasses() {
    allClasses = [];
    for (const [category, classes] of Object.entries(tailwindClasses)) {
        for (const item of classes) {
            allClasses.push({ ...item, category });
        }
    }
}
// 初始化分类标签
function initCategoryTabs() {
    const container = document.getElementById("categoryTabs");
    const categories = ["all", ...Object.keys(tailwindClasses)];
    container.textContent = "";
    categories.forEach((cat) => {
        const btn = document.createElement("button");
        btn.className = "category-tab" + (cat === "all" ? " active" : "");
        btn.dataset.category = cat;
        btn.textContent = cat === "all" ? "全部" : cat;
        container.appendChild(btn);
    });
    container.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        if (e.target.classList.contains("category-tab")) {
            document.querySelectorAll(".category-tab").forEach((t) => t.classList.remove("active"));
            e.target.classList.add("active");
            currentCategory = e.target.dataset.category;
            renderResults();
        }
    });
}
// 转义HTML
window.escapeHtml = function (text) {
    const div = document.createElement("div");
    div.textContent = text;
    return div.innerHTML;
};
// 高亮匹配文本
function highlightText(text, query) {
    if (!query)
        return escapeHtml(text);
    const escaped = escapeHtml(text);
    const regex = new RegExp(`(${query.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&")})`, "gi");
    return escaped.replace(regex, '<span class="highlight">$1</span>');
}
// 渲染结果
function renderResults() {
    const query = document.getElementById("searchInput").value.toLowerCase().trim();
    const tbody = document.getElementById("resultsBody");
    const noResults = document.getElementById("noResults");
    const stats = document.getElementById("stats");
    let filteredClasses = currentCategory === "all"
        ? allClasses
        : allClasses.filter((c) => c.category === currentCategory);
    if (query) {
        filteredClasses = filteredClasses.filter((c) => c.class.toLowerCase().includes(query) || c.css.toLowerCase().includes(query));
    }
    stats.textContent = "共 " + filteredClasses.length + " 个类名";
    if (filteredClasses.length === 0) {
        tbody.textContent = "";
        noResults.style.display = "block";
        return;
    }
    noResults.style.display = "none";
    tbody.textContent = "";
    filteredClasses.forEach((item) => {
        const tr = document.createElement("tr");
        const tdClass = document.createElement("td");
        const code = document.createElement("code");
        code.className = "class-name";
        code.innerHTML = highlightText(item.class, query);
        tdClass.appendChild(code);
        const tdCss = document.createElement("td");
        const span = document.createElement("span");
        span.className = "css-value";
        span.innerHTML = highlightText(item.css, query);
        tdCss.appendChild(span);
        const tdAction = document.createElement("td");
        const btn = document.createElement("button");
        btn.className = "copy-btn secondary outline";
        btn.textContent = "复制";
        btn.onclick = function () {
            copyToClipboard(item.class, btn);
        };
        tdAction.appendChild(btn);
        tr.appendChild(tdClass);
        tr.appendChild(tdCss);
        tr.appendChild(tdAction);
        tbody.appendChild(tr);
    });
}
// 复制到剪贴板
window.copyToClipboard = function (text, btn) {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => {
        btn.textContent = "已复制";
        btn.classList.add("copied");
        setTimeout(() => {
            btn.textContent = "复制";
            btn.classList.remove("copied");
        }, 1500);
    });
};
// 主题切换
window.toggleTheme = function () {
    const html = document.documentElement;
    const currentTheme = html.getAttribute("data-theme");
    html.setAttribute("data-theme", currentTheme === "light" ? "dark" : "light");
    localStorage.setItem("theme", html.getAttribute("data-theme"));
};
// 初始化
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    // 加载保存的主题
    const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem("theme");
    if (savedTheme) {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", savedTheme);
    }
    flattenClasses();
    initCategoryTabs();
    renderResults();
    // 搜索防抖
    let debounceTimer;
    document.getElementById("searchInput").addEventListener("input", () => {
        clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
        debounceTimer = setTimeout(renderResults, 200);
    });
});
